## Project Overview

This website was created as part of data science research analyzing Drake's commercial trajectory and streaming analytics across the music industry.

## Data Sources

1. **Billboard Hot 100 Historical Archive (TidyTuesday):**
   - Contains **2,569 weekly observations** specifically tracking songs where Drake was credited as a lead artist or featured performer between 2008 and 2021.
   - Sourced from the official [TidyTuesday Billboard repository](https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/master/data/2021/2021-09-14).

2. **Songstats Track Analytics:**
   - Real-time and catalog streaming data for the release titled **"Drake"** by Alsago & Slight Shady.
   - Available via [Songstats](https://songstats.com/track/ul9j1yr4/drake).
